explanation: This fires only at D2 after the agent chose a2 and landed in S2 by a common transition; it is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and 0 after a1 choices or rare transitions. Its size grows with time in the episode: about 0 to 1 before trial 50, 2 to 6 around trials 55 to 75, and 8 to 10 from trial 80 on (a bit lower, around 6 to 8, when the previous trial was unrewarded).
